ordinary_world.name: 平凡世界
ordinary_world.description: 主角在冒險開始前的日常環境中被介紹給讀者。他的優點、缺點和所熟悉的世界都在這裡建立。
ordinary_world.narrative_function: 建立基準現實，介紹主角，創造讓冒險意義得以成立的對比。

call_to_adventure.name: 冒險的召喚
call_to_adventure.description: 某件事打破了平凡世界——一個挑戰、問題或機遇出現，邀請或逼迫主角離開舒適圈。
call_to_adventure.narrative_function: 觸發情節的導火線。打開第一個重大選擇：主角可以回應召喚或拒絕它。

refusal_of_call.name: 拒絕召喚
refusal_of_call.description: 主角猶豫或直接拒絕召喚，表現出恐懼、懷疑或不情願。並非所有故事都明確包含這個階段。
refusal_of_call.narrative_function: 使主角更具人性，並通過展示內心必須克服的障礙來提升故事賭注。往往很短暫或只是暗示。

meeting_the_mentor.name: 遇見導師
meeting_the_mentor.description: 主角遇到一位嚮導——一個人物、物品或經歷——提供前方旅程所需的智慧、裝備或動力。
meeting_the_mentor.narrative_function: 為跨越門檻做準備。可能在故事中多次出現。導師通常無法陪伴主角進入特殊世界。

crossing_threshold.name: 跨越第一道門檻
crossing_threshold.description: 主角承諾踏上冒險，完全進入特殊世界。跨越一個不歸點，將平凡世界拋在身後。
crossing_threshold.narrative_function: 第一個重大結構轉折點。標誌著已知世界與未知世界的邊界。故事真正的賭注從這裡開始。

tests_allies_enemies.name: 考驗、盟友與敵人
tests_allies_enemies.description: 主角在特殊世界中前行，面對一系列考驗並學習其規則。結盟、識別敵人，信任被建立或打破。
tests_allies_enemies.narrative_function: 最長的階段。建立特殊世界的格局和主角不斷進化的能力。追求多個子目標。

approach_innermost_cave.name: 逼近最深處的洞穴
approach_innermost_cave.description: 主角和盟友重整旗鼓，為中心磨難做準備。這段逼近往往涉及第二道門檻、內心準備或一個懷疑的時刻。
approach_innermost_cave.narrative_function: 在核心危機前積累張力。主角最深的恐懼浮現。通常包含一個小型磨難或靈魂的黑暗之夜。

ordeal.name: 磨難
ordeal.description: 主角面對旅程中最大的危機——一個生死存亡的時刻（字面或隱喻意義上）。主角必須在某種意義上「死去」並重生。
ordeal.narrative_function: 中心結構轉折點，也是啟蒙階段的情感高潮。主角的蛻變在此鍛造完成。往往是故事最黑暗的時刻。

reward.name: 獎賞（奪取寶劍）
reward.description: 在磨難中倖存後，主角獲得獎賞——寶藏、知識、和解或力量。在回歸開始前的一個慶祝時刻。
reward.narrative_function: 承認主角的成就，並提出問題：他能守護這份獎賞嗎？為回歸階段埋下伏筆。

road_back.name: 回歸之路
road_back.description: 主角開始返回平凡世界的旅程，往往遭到追殺或威脅。回歸的決定可能需要犧牲。
road_back.narrative_function: 重新點燃緊迫感。主角必須全力投入回歸，往往面臨最後的追逐或對手的新一輪壓力。

resurrection.name: 復活
resurrection.description: 最後一次高潮考驗——主角再次被逼到極限。所有習得的教訓都被應用。最後的「死而復生」在回歸前淨化了主角。
resurrection.narrative_function: 蛻變的最終證明。主角展示自己已不再是離開平凡世界時的那個人。

return_with_elixir.name: 攜帶靈藥歸來
return_with_elixir.description: 主角帶著有價值的東西回到平凡世界——字面上的寶藏、智慧、自由或愛——使他的社群受益。
return_with_elixir.narrative_function: 閉合故事迴圈，確立旅程的意義。靈藥是冒險確實值得的證明。

ordinary_world.name: Ordinary World
ordinary_world.description: The hero is introduced in their everyday environment before the adventure begins. Strengths, weaknesses, and the familiar world are all established here.
ordinary_world.narrative_function: Establishes baseline reality, introduces the hero, and creates the contrast that gives the adventure its meaning.

call_to_adventure.name: Call to Adventure
call_to_adventure.description: Something disrupts the ordinary world — a challenge, problem, or opportunity appears, inviting or forcing the hero to leave their comfort zone.
call_to_adventure.narrative_function: The inciting incident that drives the plot. Opens the first major choice: the hero may answer the call or refuse it.

refusal_of_call.name: Refusal of the Call
refusal_of_call.description: The hero hesitates or outright refuses the call, expressing fear, doubt, or reluctance. Not all stories explicitly include this stage.
refusal_of_call.narrative_function: Makes the hero more human and raises the stakes by showing the inner obstacles to be overcome. Often brief or merely implied.

meeting_the_mentor.name: Meeting the Mentor
meeting_the_mentor.description: The hero meets a guide — a person, object, or experience — who provides the wisdom, equipment, or motivation needed for the journey ahead.
meeting_the_mentor.narrative_function: Prepares the hero for crossing the threshold. May appear multiple times in the story. The mentor typically cannot accompany the hero into the special world.

crossing_threshold.name: Crossing the First Threshold
crossing_threshold.description: The hero commits fully to the adventure, entering the special world entirely. A point of no return is crossed, leaving the ordinary world behind.
crossing_threshold.narrative_function: The first major structural turning point. Marks the boundary between the known and unknown worlds. The story's real stakes begin here.

tests_allies_enemies.name: Tests, Allies, and Enemies
tests_allies_enemies.description: The hero moves through the special world, faces a series of tests, and learns its rules. Alliances are forged, enemies identified, trust is built or broken.
tests_allies_enemies.narrative_function: The longest stage. Establishes the special world's landscape and the hero's evolving capabilities. Multiple sub-goals are pursued.

approach_innermost_cave.name: Approach to the Inmost Cave
approach_innermost_cave.description: The hero and allies regroup and prepare for the central ordeal. The approach often involves a second threshold, inner preparation, or a moment of doubt.
approach_innermost_cave.narrative_function: Builds tension before the central crisis. The hero's deepest fears surface. Often includes a minor ordeal or a dark night of the soul.

ordeal.name: Ordeal
ordeal.description: The hero faces the greatest crisis of the journey — a life-or-death moment (literal or metaphorical). The hero must 'die' and be reborn in some sense.
ordeal.narrative_function: The central structural turning point and the emotional climax of the Initiation phase. The hero's transformation is forged here. Often the story's darkest moment.

reward.name: Reward (Seizing the Sword)
reward.description: Having survived the ordeal, the hero seizes the reward — treasure, knowledge, reconciliation, or power. A moment of celebration before the return begins.
reward.narrative_function: Acknowledges the hero's achievement and poses the question: can they hold on to it? Seeds the Road Back.

road_back.name: The Road Back
road_back.description: The hero begins the journey back to the ordinary world, often pursued or threatened. The decision to return may require sacrifice.
road_back.narrative_function: Reignites urgency. The hero must fully commit to the return, often facing a final chase or renewed pressure from the antagonist.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.description: A final climactic test — the hero is pushed to the limit one last time. All lessons learned are applied. This final 'death and rebirth' purifies the hero before the return.
resurrection.narrative_function: Final proof of transformation. The hero demonstrates they are no longer the person who left the ordinary world.

return_with_elixir.name: Return with the Elixir
return_with_elixir.description: The hero returns to the ordinary world bearing something of value — literal treasure, wisdom, freedom, or love — that benefits their community.
return_with_elixir.narrative_function: Closes the story loop and establishes the journey's meaning. The elixir is proof that the adventure was truly worthwhile.
